title: Cornerstone sync scratchpad — 1:1 prep for direct: Priya Patel
body:
Purpose: quick scratchpad to run the 1:1 with Priya. Focus = unblock, align priorities for next sprint, and check on career signals. Keep it compact (30 min).

Top signals I want to surface:
- Delivery risk: infra flakiness around KV cache invalidation still sporadic (seen 2 incidents last week). Need clear owner & mitigation.
- Priya seems excited about model quantization work but blocked by infra perf regression.
- Career: looking at IC3→IC4 readiness (mentoring, cross-team influence).

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick pulse (3m): "How are you feeling about priorities + load?"
2) Blockers deep-dive (10m): KV cache incidents (logs, repros, next steps). Ask: do you need headcount help or trade-off to temporarily throttle feature?
3) Roadmap alignment (7m): review rollout plan for quantized-runtime canary — timeline, SLO targets, rollback criteria. Confirm who owns canary config and alert thresholds.
4) Career & growth (7m): recent mentoring notes, flagship doc review, what skill to prioritize.
5) Action items & quick sync on dependencies (3m).

Notes-to-self / prompts to ask:
- "Walk me through the last KV cache incident — what was different?"
- "If we paused quantization canary this sprint, what gets deprioritized?"
- "Who outside infra do you want me to pull into a short sync?"
- Check if Priya still prefers public praise in weekly-all hands or private kudos.

Data points to have ready (attach quickly):
- Incident timestamps + short timeline (ENG-2345)
- Perf dashboard: 95th/99th token latency, before/after quant change (link to dashboard)
- PRs: runtime#412 (quant canary config), infra#991 (KV cache hotfix)

Draft commitments I'm ready to make:
- Short-term: provide 1x-week contractor (2 weeks) to help reproduce flakiness OR re-scope canary for narrower traffic slice.
- Medium-term: set up focused blameless postmortem and follow-through ticket with clear owner & deadline.

Action items (capture during meeting):
- Priya: create step-by-step repro checklist and assign ticket to infra on-call (due 2026-09-04).
- Ryan (me): arrange 30m cross-team sync with Infra Leads + Priya, propose Thurs 09/03.
- Priya: update canary rollback criteria doc and link to Confluence runbook (due 2026-09-06).
- Ryan: approve up to 40 hours contractor budget for short-term debugging if Priya requests.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Consider temporary fallback: route 5% of traffic to non-quant path as emergency toggle.
- Mentorship: pair Priya with Avery on design reviews twice this quarter.
- Performance hypothesis to test: batching size + kv cache eviction interplay — run A/B with synthetic load.

Scratch / rough phrasing for feedback (keep concise):
- "You’ve moved the quantization effort a lot further than expected — nice work. I want to avoid losing momentum, so let’s clear infra blockers quickly."
- "I’m happy to escalate removal of red tape for a short-term contractor — tell me concretely what success looks like in 2 weeks."

Unresolved questions to bring up if time:
- Do we need to pause other feature work that depends on stable cache behavior?
- Is on-call rotation masking deeper reliability needs?

End note: keep this page live — I'll update after 1:1 with quick bullets under 'post-meeting update' (timestamp + outcomes).

POST-MEETING UPDATE (placeholder):
- [2026-09-02] Priya agreed to produce repro checklist; cross-team sync scheduled 09/03; I approved contractor contingency.
